skills.name: Subtract like-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract standalone fractions that already share a denominator by subtracting numerators, including cases with zero differences or improper fractions.

skills.name: Find common denominators
skills.definition: Rewrite fractions with unlike denominators as equivalent fractions with a common denominator before subtracting.

skills.name: Subtract mixed or whole numbers without regrouping
skills.definition: Subtract expressions involving whole-number parts and fractional parts when the shown fractional part of the minuend is large enough and no borrowing is needed.

skills.name: Regroup for subtraction
skills.definition: Perform mixed-number or whole-number subtraction when one whole must be borrowed from the minuend and renamed as a fraction.

skills.name: Handle improper mixed-number parts
skills.definition: Interpret and work with mixed-number terms whose fractional part is improper, such as 2 4/3.
